apps.name: Pixel Pause - Christmas Pack
apps.short_description: Unlock the shimmering Sequins style for every picture in Pixel Pause! Discover 36 varied Christmas and winter scenes to enjoy coloring at your own pace.

apps.name: Pixel Pause - Stained Glass Pack
apps.short_description: Unlock the glowing Stained Glass style for every picture in Pixel Pause! Discover 36 varied pictures inspired by stained glass, ready to bring to life with color at your own pace.

apps.name: Pixel Pause - Steampunk Pack
apps.short_description: Discover 60 varied steampunk pictures to color in Pixel Pause. Bring an imaginative world of brass, gears and curious inventions to life, one pixel at a time.

apps.name: PRAGMATA: Mega Man Pack
apps.short_description:
Mega Man love is out-of-this-world in this new bundle of outfits, gestures, and BGM.

Get two new outfits for both Hugh and Diana—each with their own way of showing off that Mega Man spirit.

apps.name: Revving: Engine Simulator - Every Engine
apps.short_description: Unlocks the seventeen engines beyond the free Honda B18C5 and Chevrolet 454: from a Harley-Davidson V-twin and a Toyota 2JZ to the Ferrari 412 T2 Formula 1 V12, the BRM H16 and the Napier Deltic. One purchase, for good.

apps.name: Road Riot: Wild Rides Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Support Road Riot with 30 Wild Rides: 20 bikes and small vehicles plus 10 unusual new rides, featuring cosmetic weapon themes. No new weapons, extra weapon damage, exclusive upgrades or paid power boosts. Requires Road Riot.

apps.name: Screw Drivers - Pretty Fly
apps.short_description: Let's take off and lift your vehicle into the sky with the new "Pretty Fly" DLC for Screw Drivers! With a variety of fancy new airplane-building blocks, you can create your very own aircraft, soar over a stunning new island, and master a whole host of exciting flying challenges.

apps.name: Starlathe - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Sixteen cosmetic pieces in four matching sets: ship skins, station skins, engine trails and portrait frames for Starlathe. Looks only, no gameplay advantage of any kind. Every purchase helps me keep building the game.

apps.name: THE IDOLM@STER STARLIT SEASON - Rinze's Stage production set
Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Blood Pack DLC
World of Warships x Azur Lane — Quest for AL Avrora
apps.short_description: A real treat for super fans of Azur Lane, this free DLC will unlock a very special mission indeed. By completing it, not only will you unlock an individually-voiced Commander from the universe of Azur Lane, but you’ll also get a Premium cruiser inspired by the very same Commander—Avrora!

apps.name: 富翁派对 - 高级时装 / Rich Bash - Premium Fashion
apps.short_description: Unlock premium fashion content and enter the game with enhanced character modeling

apps.name: 10 Milion Cubes
apps.short_description: Break through 10 million voxels to find the Prismatic Cube. A short incremental game about satisfying destruction with really bouncy balls.

apps.name: 10 Second Mixtape
apps.short_description: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

apps.name: 2 birds 1 stone
apps.short_description:
Kill birds, get paid, then buy stuff to kill more birds, get paid more, then buy more stuff to kill even more birds, get paid even more...

Clicker / idler / incremental entertainment for the whole family (or just you, we don't judge).

apps.name: 99 NIGHTS IN THE APOCALYPSE
apps.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op survival game. Team up with friends to survive 99 nights in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, build your camp, craft weapons, explore different biomes, and fight off waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

apps.name: 999 Seconds! Survivors
apps.short_description:
Reject boring stat stacking!
We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create?
—Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!
A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

apps.name: A.M.C.A.: Monitor
apps.short_description: A survival horror game where you defend yourself from threats while looking out for anomalies.

apps.name: After Dark Pinas - Check in
apps.short_description: Welcome to the world of After Dark Pinas! In this episode you play as Ian, a 20 year old Filipino college student who met his crush through online classes. Live in your Lola's house, do chores, tumakas sa gabi, and encounter Filipino supernatural moments that leads to a Horrific Check In Episode!

apps.name: After Hours: Library
apps.short_description: Survive a haunted library's overnight shift by balancing authentic librarian duties with stealth as a relentless supernatural entity hunts you. Uncover hidden secrets, survive until morning, and discover what waits between the shelves.

apps.name: AI Digital Human Lab
apps.short_description: Meet Luna, a lifelike AI companion who lives on your PC: talk by voice or text and she answers in her own voice, with 74 expressions and natural gestures, all on-device. Scan a QR code and your own AI agent (Muse, Claude, any MCP app) can direct her: lights, camera, outfits, dance, songs.

apps.name: Airborne Ranger: FightOut
apps.short_description: Gear up in Airborne Ranger: Fightout, a thrilling tactical-action game. Play solo or jump in 4-player co-op as you take on missions behind enemy lines—eliminate targets, gather intel, sabotage infrastructure and rescue hostages. Rely on skill, strategy, and courage to survive and make it out alive!

apps.name: Alderfolk
apps.short_description: Found a village and grow it into a living valley, shared by foxes, otters, badgers, hares, humans, elves and dwarves. Run farms, mills and bakeries, raise heirs, hold festivals and meet neighbouring villages. A cosy settlement builder, rich in detail, in a painted storybook style.

apps.name: Alien Invasyndrome
apps.short_description: Sneak around, evade and wait for the right time to strike! Breed hot girls and make it your erotic nest~

apps.name: Ambulante Simulator
apps.short_description: Become a beach vendor in Copacabana! Fill your cooler, shout your sales pitch into a real microphone and sell water, mate tea and Globo biscuits to thirsty beachgoers. Up to 6 friends on the same beach, proximity voice chat, and the biggest profit wins.

apps.name: Ancient
apps.short_description: Ancient is a third person exploration game developed by MinoDab Productions

apps.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
apps.short_description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

apps.name: Ant Now?
apps.short_description: Eight players, four colonies, one backyard. You play as a duo: one commands the nest from the war room below, the other defends the anthill outside. Build your colony, hold the line and storm the other nests. In the end, only one queen survives.

apps.name: Apoc Tank: Rush Forward
apps.short_description: Drive your tank through zombie hordes! Backpack-like + roguelike bullet-heaven shooter. Merge weapons, upgrade tanks, collect energy cores & sets, research tech. 5 difficulties from easy to inferno.

apps.name: Architect of Ruin
apps.short_description: Architect of Ruin is a completely hand drawn sword and sorcery colony simulation game. Farm, hunt, build, and survive as you rebuild an ancient temple under the gaze of a vengeful god.

apps.name: Ardent Arcana
apps.short_description: Solo or with up to three friends online, take on the beasts of French folklore in this co-op dungeon roguelite. Wield 14 weapons, master the 22 Major Arcana and fight your way down five procedural dungeons to the boss waiting at the bottom.

apps.name: Armed Supremacy
apps.short_description: Build your base and command a modern army in a large-scale RTS. Fight across land, sea and air, flank enemy armor and develop your forces through research and combat. Enable zombie hordes and hold your defenses through the night.

apps.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
apps.short_description: ART NOIRE: Paris is an atmospheric ring-based puzzle game that combines classic film noir aesthetics with the romantic elegance of 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings, align the details, and restore beautiful illustrations.

apps.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS
apps.short_description: Fight through a shifting rift in a 3D action roguelite. Choose Lumi, Bram, or Nox; master their distinct melee, shield, and rune abilities; shape each five-room expedition with routes and blessings; and face the Swarm Heart alongside AI companions.

apps.name: Ashigaru
apps.short_description: Ashigaru Tactics is a turn-based hex tactical combat sandbox game, set in Sengoku-era Japan. Assemble a squad of mercenaries and fight, survive, and kill in a land ravaged by clan wars, bandit incursions, and whispers of Yokai emerging.

apps.name: Astral 4X : Interstellar Simulation
apps.short_description: A deep-space 4X simulation. Explore a procedurally generated universe, colonize worlds, build a realistic economy, and lead your civilization toward galactic domination. Brave ecological and economic crises, face famines, wars, and disasters, and ensure your survival!

apps.name: ATK：画境小镇
apps.short_description: ATK: Painting Realm Town is a casual and fun auto-battler that integrates tavern chess strategic gameplay, in-depth character development, and random equipment collection. Players can unlock more than twenty distinctive characters with entirely unique styles and personalities.

apps.name: Ayalga
apps.short_description: Fermín's crew went down the mine, and at noon the cage came up empty. Your turn: that's what the new guy is for. A horde-survival roguelite with a story and an ending: ten floors of creatures from Asturian legend, a boss on every one, and the Diañu laughing at you all the way down.

apps.name: B.C. Piezophile
apps.short_description:
B.C. Piezophile is a first-person action horror game set deep underwater. It
features a foreign ocean brimming with ambivalent environments, hazardous
anomalies and baroque ecosystems. Stranded in the hadal zone, the player must
ascend over 6,150 AeC before they can dream of rescue.

apps.name: BACKBITE
apps.short_description: Snake, but as a duel. Two snakes, one board and five powers to sabotage each other. And dying first doesn't mean losing: the one who ate more wins, not the one who survived.

apps.name: Backrooms:Betrayal
apps.short_description: Maintain reality or watch it collapse. Backrooms: Betrayal is a co-op liminal horror game where the environment is the antagonist. Stabilize shifting sectors against a tide of entropy, but watch your team. Every failure has an explanation, but not every explanation is innocent.

apps.name: Backseat Champions
apps.short_description: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?

apps.name: Barry the Antivirus
apps.short_description: Your computer is under attack, and the antivirus is a very angry bear. Slingshot Barry into waves of viruses, bounce off the walls, collect coins, and upgrade your way through an endless pixel-art invasion on a desktop straight out of the '90s.

apps.name: Because It's There
apps.short_description: An engineering/survival game where you summit the tallest mountain in a vast, uncharted world. For the journey, carefully construct flying wooden bases with realistic structural failures. Brave thunderstorms, freezing temperatures, bears and wolves. Answer the call of the untamed wilderness.

apps.name: Better Together
apps.short_description: A 2 to 6 player co-op psychological horror. Become neighbors with your friends in an underground experiment. Complete the studies, get paid by doing tasks, while the Institute notes your routine. Betray your friends before they do. In the end you'll know exactly who your friends really are.

apps.name: Beyond The Cradle
apps.short_description:
Grow a civilisation across a persistent galaxy that keeps running while you are away.
Research, colonise and automate your worlds, make peace and trade with rival empires,
and reach beyond your cradle.

apps.name: Beyond The Mist
apps.short_description: M. Webb, the I.S.C. requests your immediate presence. Our previous keeper has vanished without explanation. A replacement is needed at once for the offshore lighthouse under our care. Report to the local office of the company as soon as possible. Do not be late.

apps.name: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Newly released from prison, you've been sent to a distant space station to manage a general store. This is your last chance at redemption and the authorities are watching. Can you keep your nose clean and still earn a profit in this trading simulator?

apps.name: Blackboard Ponies
apps.short_description:
A game about a small pony in a blackboard world wreaking havoc and bringing color to everyone's lives. 

In this puzzle platformer play as a student's rebellious fantasy pony, kicking its way through the blackboard and releasing colors from the environment, making the world seem less hopeless.

apps.name: Blackstar Ranger
apps.short_description: Blackstar Ranger is a high-octane and immersive first-person space shooter. From the seat of your advanced fighter, you will complete contracts for BLACKSTAR, the most esteemed Private Military Faction in the solar system. With 6DOF capability, you will battle threats throughout the system.

apps.name: Blawkade
apps.short_description: ANOMALY DETECTED. You are the anomaly. Race through 28 sectors in a fast paced 2D puzzle-platformer. Dodge blocks, collect power-ups, and phase through obstacles to reach each transporter before you're erased. Escape solo or with friends.

apps.name: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven
apps.short_description: 112 smoothie weapons. Six slots. Discover powerful combos, mow down hordes, and take on towering Bounty Bosses in this colorful 3D bullet heaven. Turn fruit into firepower and build your own recipe for destruction.

apps.name: Blind Frontiers
apps.short_description: Take the road to the elusive Golden City. Blind Frontiers is a narrative road trip blending RPG and survival, where the destination matters less than the state of mind you arrive in. Drive through collapsing worlds at the wheel of your one makeshift companion: your truck.

apps.name: Blind Seek
apps.short_description: Blind Seek is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where the hiders are invisible, but definitely not silent. Complete tasks, grab ridiculous power-ups, and escape before the seeker hears your footsteps or catches you yapping in voice chat with you friends!

apps.name: Bluff or Bust
apps.short_description: Bluff or Bust is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Persian Gol ya Pooch, where players hide and track a Goal ball using observation, intelligence, and reading body language.

apps.name: Boardroom & Chassis
apps.short_description: Build a car empire from a single factory. Design, manufacture, and sell cars across decades of history while three rivals fight you for every customer. Compete fair - or play dirty with corporate espionage, sabotage, and the stock market. Can you build an industry giant?

apps.name: BONEWOOD
apps.short_description: Cut through waves of orcs, undead and other wretched enemies of the realm! Gather your units and equip them with powerful gear, place your traps, level up your hero and unlock new talents. Discover mad builds and insane synergies that will help you defend endlessly! Play solo or co-op!

apps.name: Botinator
apps.short_description: Descend into the depths of the facility to uncover the cause behind the madness. Blow robotic creatures into pieces and fight through mind bending environmental challenges. Use various physics based mechanics to force your way through a lethal mixture of combat and puzzles.

apps.name: Brand of Betrayal
apps.short_description: In this NTR RPG, play as Rein on a mission to defeat the Demon King. With your wife and two childhood friends, fight enemies, explore, and grow stronger as you unlock steamy events. Power comes at a cost though, and you will not be the one to pay it. How far will your team go to achieve its goal?

apps.name: BREACHPOINT
apps.short_description: Frag out like you're a teenager again. BREACHPOINT is a fast paced arena FPS featuring both classic modes and an Endless Singleplayer/Co-Op progression mode against hordes of enemies and bosses. Play Online or in LAN!

apps.name: Brick Buddies
apps.short_description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

apps.name: BrickAmp
apps.short_description: Two brick-breakers in one: AMPED runs fast and loud, ZEN reshapes the same 100 levels onto a slower, calmer board. Charge the Smash meter to blow out whole clusters of bricks in one hit — and play it all to your own music, or whatever's already playing.

apps.name: British Pub Simulator
apps.short_description: Take ownership of a derelict pub in 1980s Britain and turn it into a proper local. Pull pints, stock the cellar, serve the punters, furnish and decorate the place, enjoy classic pub games and build the boozer your way.

apps.name: Brothel Virgin - The Crimson Reverie
apps.short_description: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

apps.name: Brute Tusk : Feral
apps.short_description: Play as a feral boar and fight the animals of the wild. Charge, bite, and dodge through every clash. Eat what you kill, evolve mid-run, and grow into a deadlier beast.

apps.name: Burnknowe Golf Club
apps.short_description: A cosy golf club tycoon in a painted Scottish landscape. Design the course, sculpt the ground, keep the greens perfect and your members happy, and grow your club from a handful of holes into a destination worth the trip.

apps.name: Bye Bye Bonnie
apps.short_description: Bye Bye Bonnie is a co-op journey for up to 4 players set in a dystopian wasteland. Tee-up a giant talking skull to defy physics, conquer dungeons, help strange NPCs, and find lost siblings. Upgrade your skull to ascend The Tower. Mother is waiting...

apps.name: Cable Arrange
apps.short_description: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

apps.name: Call From The Deep
apps.short_description: Call From The Deep is a gripping first-person co-op horror experience. Crew a submarine with up to 8 friends and descend into a haunted abyss. Patch the leaks, fend off nightmares, and hold the hull together as you dive ever deeper — for fortune and glory, or be lost to the tide.

apps.name: Calvary and Swords
apps.short_description: Build a settlement, raise an army, and fight alongside your troops in a medieval sandbox. Customize your character, develop your skills, and command infantry, archers, and cavalry. Play solo against AI or join friends for a co-op experience.

apps.name: Camp Manager Simulator
apps.short_description: Ever dreamed of running your own campground? Turn a quiet lakeside campsite into a thriving resort! Rent out tents, caravans, and bungalows. Unlock fishing, offer ATV and canoe rentals, hire staff, and keep every camper happy.

apps.name: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
apps.short_description: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

apps.name: Capy of Gods
apps.short_description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

apps.name: Carmilla : Crimson Moon
apps.short_description: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

apps.name: Castlebound
apps.short_description: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

apps.name: Caveblazers Together
apps.short_description: Caveblazers Together is an online multiplayer mod for Caveblazers - team up with up to 3 friends on your adventures!

apps.name: Chess:Arcade
apps.short_description: Learn chess by playing it. Master the rules, openings, endgames and tactics, then put your skills to the test in Arcade mode, against eight computer opponents, or against friends. Real chess, unchanged — just more approachable, playful and alive.

apps.name: ChromaBreak
apps.short_description: ChromaBreak is a high-speed rhythm action bullet-hell sidescroller. Graze deadly neon hazards, trigger shockwave parries, switch color polarities, and defeat colossal geometric bosses to claim their weapons in heart-pounding solo or local 2-player co-op combat.

apps.name: Chronicle of Gods
apps.short_description: You are one god in a pantheon of rivals. On living worlds of wandering peoples, rising cities and warring realms, gods compete for faith and mortals toil. Older than any realm, the Chronicle remembers the deeds of mortals and gods alike. Can anyone prove which were yours?

apps.name: Chronicle of Heroes
apps.short_description: Build, Quest, Defend! Build a city and recruit heroes to quest for power and glory, and to defend against ever increasing waves of darkness. Can you grow mighty enough to stand against the coming storm?

apps.name: CityZen
apps.short_description: Build a city from humble beginnings into an industrial metropolis. Manage supply chains, meet your citizens’ needs, and keep essential services running in a deep economic simulation that rewards good planning without demanding perfection.

apps.name: Clawsome
apps.short_description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

apps.name: ConEX
apps.short_description: A twin-stick shooter roguelite with a destination. Mow down thousands of zombies to deliver a package, then make it back to your van alive. Build your loadout mid-run, upgrade your gear between shifts, and turn every handcrafted pixel-art route into a bloodbath.

apps.name: Contested Space: Core Defender
apps.short_description: The first pack opening defense game you can play with friends! Crack booster packs to build your fleet, defend your core, and aim your own cannon while your stations fire. 1-4 player online co-op, short runs, hundreds of unlocks. Set in the Contested Space universe.

apps.name: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
apps.short_description: When Souta’s cosplay-filled camera gets broken, the Yamakake sisters volunteer to be cosplay models for him. After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?

apps.name: CottageCore
apps.short_description: Build freely, shape cottages and towers, and welcome a village into your glade. Organize village life and prepare homes and supplies for winter. A cozy building game about making a place of your own and caring for the people who live there.

apps.name: Crimson Harvest
apps.short_description: Plant, water, and harvest crops in a PS1-inspired farming horror game. Sell crops to buy seeds and upgrades, or sacrifice them for the Harvest at the week's end all while trying to survive unique horrifying creatures that emerge with each passing day.

apps.name: Crowned Sun
apps.short_description: An isometric action MMORPG of androids and erased cities. Wake in Cradle-19 as a Ninth Generation Wanderer, fight machines with blade and Drone, shape your build with Plug-in Chips, and remember the places the world was made to forget.

apps.name: Crowns & Colossi
apps.short_description: Choose among 13 distinct fantasy kingdoms: appoint ministers, balance the treasury and maneuver on the world map, then command legions in turn-based battles with war-strategy cards and towering giants. Roguelike runs, branching stories and multiple endings.

apps.name: Crownspat
apps.short_description: Lead your kingdom against three rivals in a lighthearted real-time strategy game. Command troops, claim territory, build villages and defenses, manage taxes and resources, and outmaneuver your enemies across colorful isometric battlefields.

apps.name: Cubes&Cards
apps.short_description: Cubes & Cards is a Rougelike Platform Fighter; Fight your friends and gain power from over 30 cards to choose from! With 3 characters with unique playstyles, the possibilities are endless!

apps.name: Cubic Earth
apps.short_description: Explore all of Earth in stunning detail, down to street level! From New York to London and beyond, there are millions of real places to uncover.

apps.name: Cups and Curses
apps.short_description: A cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks from ingredients whose effects you discover by using them, plan your board around the morning forecast, and offer them to the people at your counter. No timer and no fail state. Regulars come back, sit down, and tell you things.

apps.name: Curse of Baghdad
apps.short_description: A top-down military shooter with a rich story about brotherhood when surviving an unknown curse. Face the odds and escape with your life from this unprecedented threat that lurks in the shadows of Baghdad, Iraq.

apps.name: Dark Fracture
apps.short_description: Dark Fracture is a psychological horror experience in which you explore an ever-changing world where reality and nightmares collide. Walk on the edge of madness in the shoes of a tormented soul as you descend into the darkest depths of the human psyche, and question everything you see.

apps.name: Dark Samurai
apps.short_description: Dark Samurai is a roguelike horde survival game with online co-op multiplayer and persistent progression, set in feudal Japan overrun by demons.

apps.name: Dawn's Wake
apps.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

apps.name: DD33
apps.short_description: Five dice, five enemy lanes, and a perfectly sensible plan that has yet to survive its first roll. Build poker-style combos, combine cards, and upgrade your dice in a 33-round turn-based roguelike. Luck matters. Leaving it in charge is another matter entirely.

apps.name: DEAD ON FILE
apps.short_description: Detroit, 1998. Investigate crimes through an old police OS: examine documents, connect clues and test alibis. Choose whom to accuse, a motive and evidence for court. Your theory could put an innocent person behind bars. Will you spot the evidence that proves it wrong?

apps.name: Death 1879
apps.short_description: A single-player, first-person mystery set in 1879. Play as Death, explore a village, speak with its inhabitants, gather information and consult your Book as you investigate its secrets.

apps.name: Decay Constant
apps.short_description: Warning. Surveillance and detection systems inactive. Multiple subject containment failure. Facility compromised. I wonder what’ll happen to you? SURREAL SINGLE PLAYER ACTION ORIENTED HALF-LIFE 2 MOD

apps.name: Decayed Cases: Archive 22
apps.short_description: The peaceful, familiar everyday life is completely turned upside down by the chaos that has erupted at the base. The silence of the archive is dissapear, leaving nothing but survival. Will I ever get to tell the story of everything I’ve been through, or will I, too, become a part of the archive?

apps.name: Demon Castle Guard
apps.short_description: You are the Demon Lord, and every woman in the land wants to move into your castle. The rejected ones show up with armies for a "hostile job interview." Merge slimes, hold the gate, and pass them all. A cheeky pixel-art tower defense comedy with adult content.

apps.name: Desktop Goofy Guys
apps.short_description: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

apps.name: Destroy the Flag
apps.short_description: Destroy the Flag is a chaotic multiplayer bomb-battler — they get launched, frozen, and hurled across the map instead. Blast your way to the enemy flag before they blast you first, and survive absurd random events like meteor strikes, bouncing dodgeballs, and rogue ice cubes.

apps.name: Die Severed
apps.short_description: Die Severed is a gambling roguelike where each lost round costs you one finger. Stack your dice bag with weighted dice, collect run defining abilities, and push your luck to pay your debt and walk out in one piece. More or less.

apps.name: Dirtville
apps.short_description: Welcome to small, sunny and abandoned Balkan town where something is quietly wrong. Upgrade your character, abilities and tools in a cozy place where cleaning and digging is how you investigate the world. Dirtville is a mix of satisfying casual mechanics and story-based exploration.

apps.name: Divine Ember
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn cavern adventure. Walk the Green Caverns until your map remembers them, swear vows for tuniks, and wear amulets that change how you fight and find the way out.

apps.name: Divine Frequency
apps.short_description: A fever dream experience about the total collapse of reality as it lingers between states of erasure and transcendence.

apps.name: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft
apps.short_description: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft is a toilet-humour clicker set in a bubbling sewer laboratory. Click to make dookie, build ten ridiculous factories from the Whoopie Cushion to the Methane Volcano, snatch random power-ups and grow your stinkiest empire yet.

apps.name: Dreamsend: Wintersong
apps.short_description: Experience a new approach to turn-based tactical combat in this 2.5D cyberpunk fantasy Strategy RPG. Empower your roster with abilities and items inspired by genre classics and MOBAs. Face unforgiving battles and grand multiphase bossfights to shape the fate of Veichne, the land of eternal winters.

apps.name: Dungeon Packer
apps.short_description: Dungeon Packer is the inventory management roguelike. Strategically place items in your backpack to trigger synergies between them and score enough points to defeat monsters. Discover crazy synergies, optimize your inventory, and enjoy the journey in this hypnotically satisfying game!

apps.name: Dying Patience
apps.short_description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

apps.name: Eastfold Club Manager
apps.short_description:
Relive the golden days of football manager games in the 90’s.

Take control of a low league team in Europe or an established super club.

Control the squad, your staff, finances, transfers.

Get talent from abroad and grow your youth to superstars.

apps.name: Ebon Age Tactics
apps.short_description: Turn-based tactics in a world without magic, at the moment magic arrives. Resources are shared between units — spend the party's movement and mana where the fighting is, and make every action worthwhile.

apps.name: Elroy Goes Bugzerk
apps.short_description: The 90s point-and-click classic returns! Help Elroy and Blue find the legendary Technoloptera to win the 10th Annual Insectathon. Outsmart arch-rival Gordon Smugs, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and learn real science in this fully animated interactive adventure story.

apps.name: Elroy Hits the Pavement
apps.short_description: Blue has been dog-napped! Join Elroy and Syd in this comedic, fully animated, point-and-click adventure to rescue Elroy's dog and recover their stolen science project before summer school. Solve clever puzzles using lasers, codes, and battery power, and shape the story in this 90s classic!

apps.name: Elroy's Costume Closet
apps.short_description: The 1996 Headbone Interactive classic is back! Help Elroy and Syd save the Camelian Theater in this retro restored dress-up game. Mix wild outfits to unlock 75+ funny, fully voiced short animated skits. A retro revival packed with original 90s magic, optimized for modern desktops!

apps.name: Elroy: King of the Jungle
apps.short_description: A Brand-New 30-Year-Old Game. This 90's animated point-and-click adventure is finally released! Crash-land in a dangerous jungle with Elroy, his sidekick Blue AND Elroy’s annoying little brother Slim. Solve puzzles, survive crazy calamities, and navigate challenges to bring everyone home safe.

apps.name: Elven Watcher
apps.short_description: To protect the future of the Elven race and to avenge those who have perished, wage war upon the foul Undead!

apps.name: Emanet - Kalanların Hikayesi
apps.short_description: Datça, 1987. Run a seaside left-luggage counter: compare claim tickets, items and the ledger, catch the lies and decide who walks away with what. By night, chase Elif, who vanished seven years ago, through crayon-drawn dreams that regain their colour as you draw near.

apps.name: Epoch Forge
apps.short_description: A 2D colony simulator and sandbox where you make a name for yourself in a dying world. You can type freely to anyone, and they remember what you did. Mine, build, wire logic circuits, appease five silent gods, and push the limits of reality. No ending, no win screen. Pace yourself.

apps.name: Eris One Stand
apps.short_description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot ’em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

apps.name: Eternal Conquest
apps.short_description: A competitive multiplayer action RPG where players battle for dominance in a dynamic world, earning powerful rewards and ranking through challenging PvE encounters.

apps.name: Evoplasm
apps.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

apps.name: Explore the Universe 2175
apps.short_description: MEGABOT arrives in 12 minutes. Discover an ancient alien defense network, blast-mine through asteroids in physics-driven combat, enhance your ship, discover allies, and friendly NPCs then hold the line when the machine armada comes for you. A roguelite space survival game in a galaxy at war.

apps.name: Extreme Paddle Board
apps.short_description: Stand up, paddle hard and try not to fall in. Race stand-up paddle boards down wild rivers round the world, through rapids, over waterfalls and off kickers, with friends bumping you into the water. Wobble, wipe out, climb back on, win.

apps.name: Fallen Memory
apps.short_description: Nathan, who has no memory of his past, wakes up in a dark house he doesn’t recognize. Every door that opens forces us to confront our past. In this psychological horror game, you must uncover the truth behind your lost memories while facing dark secrets and mental collapse.

apps.name: FALLENMAGE Received: Hypnosis's Curse
apps.short_description: An adult RPG focusing on hypnosis and mind break. Explore the town and talk to marked NPCs to easily trigger events. With complex combat removed, you can fully focus on pleasure. Featuring 100+ CGs and Live2D animations, witness a rational mage girl fall into a trap and succumb to lust!

apps.name: Femboy Futa Casino
apps.short_description: Deal cards, uncover secrets, and choose who to trust at The Velvet Ace. An adult visual novel featuring femboy and futanari characters, six romance routes, 10 minigames, and multiple endings. Can you save a casino drowning in debt and find someone worth staying for?

apps.name: Fiak
apps.short_description: Four nights of survival in a realistic, immersive horror experience. Alone in your house, you face a malicious entity determined to get inside. This is not a walking simulator: every decision affects your survival. One mistake is fatal.

apps.name: Fire and Brim Co.
apps.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

apps.name: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT.
apps.short_description: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot – fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

apps.name: First Layer: 3D Printing Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own 3D printing workshop! Prepare models, run your printers, and complete orders. Manage filament stock, plan production, and sell your products. Invest in new printers, expand your workshop, and grow your business layer by layer.

apps.name: Fitz's Aim Trainer
apps.short_description: An FPS aim trainer that runs natively on Mac and Windows. 30 default excercises along  custom excercise creation. There is a ranked benchmark mode ranging from Mortal to Omnipotent, global leaderboards and custom excercise sharing. Made by one person who just wanted an aim trainer for Mac.

apps.name: FlipBAKA
apps.short_description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies — and friends — off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round! Dungeon demo has online co-op. Downloads planned to end with Steam Next Fest.

apps.name: Follow Suit
apps.short_description: Playing card games (Spades, Hearts, Solitaire, Freecell, more coming) with your friends, vs bots, or solo. Make a table, share a code or link, and play between any devices. Bots fill empty seats, choose rule sets or adjust individual options.

apps.name: Forgefall
apps.short_description: Forgefall is an active incremental game where your lantern cuts through a scrolling forest. Break trees, rocks, goblins, and chests, aim the resources they drop, build processors, and buy permanent upgrades that make each run more productive.

apps.name: From Ruins
apps.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

apps.name: Fuji Flip
apps.short_description:
Flip two cards. Hear the word. Match the pair.
 Fuji Flip is a memory card game for language learners: every card shows a picture and a word and says it out loud,
 so you pick up real Japanese, Spanish and French words while you play.

apps.name: Fully Funded
apps.short_description: Practice for a prop firm evaluation with your friends. One shared account, the same kinds of rules (daily loss limit, trailing drawdown, profit targets), pro-style charts with indicators and drawing tools, and a room full of things to throw when someone blows it.

apps.name: Furmageddon
apps.short_description:
Haha! I'm in! I hacked the devs' Steam page! 🦝
Rizzo here. Get ready for a 1-4 player online co-op roguelite bullet heaven. Pick your Furmate, build crazy loadouts and see how long you can survive solo or team up with friends to take on hordes of monsters. What could possibly go wrong?

apps.name: Get Outta My Gut
apps.short_description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

apps.name: Glacis
apps.short_description: You can't block the enemy's road, but you can move the earth. Raise the ground to bend their path, put your guns on the heights, and hold the same corridor through three wars, from towed guns and dive bombers to helicopter assaults and drone swarms.

apps.name: Gloosh!
apps.short_description: Run, jump and dash through a momentum-driven 3D platformer with incremental progression. Record runs, let clones earn income, buy upgrades and return faster. Refine your routes, collect stars and chase better course times in Gloosh!

apps.name: Gonggi: Recess
apps.short_description: Recess. Five gonggi stones on your desk. Scatter, toss, pick up and catch them with a physics-driven hand. Play from Onesies to the Flip on your own or against your seatmate or a Steam friend, and between rounds get up to doodle on the chalkboard and play the reed organ.

apps.name: Gore and Grace
apps.short_description: Gore and Grace is a single-player 2D top-down action RPG. Slay vicious monsters, scavenge gear to survive, and build your skills against elite foes. Death is the norm — every fall brings you closer to victory. Between gore and grace, earn your glory and title.

apps.name: Grass-n-Gnomes
apps.short_description: Play as a lawnmower with the mission to cut and trim lawns of magical grass across different biomes, infested with colorful Gnomes.

apps.name: Grr Grr Gnomes
apps.short_description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

apps.name: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights
apps.short_description: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights is a gym-themed organizing game supporting up to 4 players online. Clean up the fitness space and get some exercise along the way. Some heavy dumbbells cannot be lifted right from the start.

apps.name: Half-Life Legacy
apps.short_description: Relive Half-Life 1 with bug fixes, enhanced controller support, Steam Achievements, bunny-hopping, Steam Workshop support, and more, in the ultimate restoration.
developers: FOUNDATION Project - The Phoenix Project Software SVG

apps.name: HALF-LIFE: CROSS PRODUCT
apps.short_description: The multiplayer component of HALF-LIFE: CROSS PRODUCT, an ambitious game whose campaign has been in development since 2020. Experience fast, extensively customizable combat with dynamic modes, expanded weaponry, advanced movement, and years of evolving content.
developers: CONFLUX Project - The Phoenix Project Software SVG
Adrenaline Gamer Team (MP original codebase development)

apps.name: Halloween Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Manage a Halloween shop in a town full of monsters. Furnish your home, adopt a weird pet, explore the streets and discover a nightlife full of secrets, smugglers and spooky surprises.

apps.name: Hands of the Sovereign
apps.short_description:
It's time to duel on Fardea Island! Encounter a colourful cast of rivals! Challenge your host: Lord Blackthorn!
Assemble your own personal deck, and do battle upon a grid-based battlefield.

apps.name: Hapervil
apps.short_description: Play as Amaya and Wil, navigating a forsaken orphanage where secrets lurk in the dark. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and survive a psychological horror tale where innocence twists into nightmare and shadows patiently wait to strike.

apps.name: Heatwarped
apps.short_description: Ratfield sits atop an underground racing scene. Conquer the streets by warping the odds in your favor. Customize your ride to the max, meet up with other racers from your pda's racing forum to compete, and build respect.

apps.name: Heavy in the Hand
apps.short_description: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

apps.name: HEME
apps.short_description: A short 2D side-scrolling narrative game about love and a bond that others may never understand.

apps.name: HexaFootball
apps.short_description: HexaFootball is a turn-based football strategy game where chess-like decisions replace reflexes. Build your team, manage action points, and outthink your opponent on a hex grid. Every pass, every move, and every match is a battle of pure tactics.

apps.name: Hidden in Plain Cake
apps.short_description: Sculpt, slice, and paint real cake into perfect copies of everyday objects — then invite your friends online to spot the fake. Every cut reveals the sponge layers inside. Fool them, or get sliced open trying.

apps.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
apps.short_description: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

apps.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon
apps.short_description: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.

apps.name: Horny Slots: Spin to Sin
apps.short_description: At this casino, every winning spin fuels not only the thrill of the game, but the interest of the local girls. Place your bets, land winning combinations, and see how far luck takes you – the better you play, the bolder their desires and the more they reveal themselves to you.

apps.name: House Of Echoes
apps.short_description: Its eyes are piercing into your soul from the darkness with ever growing anger. It won't leave you alone until you solve the puzzles and uncover your traumatic past. Can you work out all of the unique puzzles and find out what happened before it all fades into nothingness?

apps.name: Human Resources
apps.short_description:
Race through fast-paced levels while killing clones in increasingly absurd ways!

Unlock all the medals, get promoted, beat your friends times, and discover the secrets of the Human Resources department.

apps.name: I Saw a Flying Saucer
apps.short_description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

apps.name: I Swear I Parked Here
apps.short_description: You swear you parked right here. Now find your car among thousands of identical ones. Start with an old-fashioned key, upgrade to a remote with growing range, take your time and conquer lots with 1,000 to 50,000 cars, and beyond.

apps.name: iceman
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn papercut desktop pet with blind-box collecting and Pomodoro focus. A fridge-bellied grandpa and a big-mouthed cow cat live in your screen corner

apps.name: Idle Hoops
apps.short_description: An incremental idle basketball game. Shoot hoops, sign a roster that ends with an actual goat, and let your team keep scoring while you're away. Win championships, hang your retired jersey in the rafters, and work your way up from the driveway to a court in outer space.

apps.name: Idyll
apps.short_description: A 3D voxel fantasy colony sim with online co-op. Build a settlement block-by-block, mine deep for rare resources, craft powerful gear, and defend your colonists from monsters and rival factions.

apps.name: IncrementalOS
apps.short_description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

apps.name: INK MAZE
apps.short_description: Chart your own path through a fog-shrouded dungeon in INK MAZE! Design cryptic treasure maps to solve puzzles, outsmart traps, and collect loot hidden within the mist. But when you reach the depths of the maze, will you still be able to decipher the symbols you charted long ago?

apps.name: Inkturn
apps.short_description: A compact puzzle game about guiding two inkfish one at a time to collect every star. Each star switches control to the other. Think ahead and leave the right trail. It blocks one inkfish but helps the other.

apps.name: Intersingles
apps.short_description:
A competitive fps for your best friend group.
Up to 6 players can compete in the round-robin singles(1v1) format match. Play against your best friends or players around the globe.

apps.name: Irish Sport Manager
apps.short_description: A management sim for the Gaelic games: football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football. Take a county, pick your fifteen from the clubs inside it, and answer to a board that remembers everything.

apps.name: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q
apps.short_description: Bandmates Iz and her robot Auggie wrote a killer song. Cosmo LaRue stole it. Recover the song from Dimension Q in this animated point-and-click puzzle adventure from 1996: descramble codes, outrun the Q cops, crack a musical lock, and rescue missing secret agents.

apps.name: Janet DeMornay Is A Slumlord (and a witch)
apps.short_description: RENT MONEY IS DEAD MONEY and your landlord is expecting payment IN FULL. Puzzle your way out of a maze of DEPRAVED magical appliances and the UNHINGED diaries of a DEBAUCHED faded television celebrity.

apps.name: Jerry and Jaspers Jovial Journey
apps.short_description: Jerry and Jasper is a simple RPG experience involving traditional turn based combat, mission variations based on player choices, and various unique puzzles. Filled with dozens of impactful choices, every variation of Jerry and Jaspers Journey is bound to be unique.

apps.name: Kasane
apps.short_description: Layer colors to recreate a target pattern exactly. Red, blue and yellow blend where they overlap, and the same color layered twice cancels out and vanishes. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, verified by an exhaustive count — 1000 of them, from three pieces on a 4x4 board to twelve on a 5x5.

apps.name: Keep an Eye
apps.short_description: Play as Tom, a robot private detective in a city full of secrets. Find suspects, tail them in disguise, record conversations, take photos, and hack systems in this single-player story adventure. Upgrade your investigative abilities and fight your way out when a case turns dangerous.

apps.name: Keyword Disaster Arena
apps.short_description: Create your own disasters by combining keyword cards in a chaotic 4-player physics-based party survival game. Everyone's disasters happen at once. Dodge the danger, shove your rivals into trouble, and survive the chaos you helped create!

apps.name: Kill You Again
apps.short_description: A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel. Wake up as Haru, a streamer trapped in a beautiful fantasy world that resets with every death. Uncover hidden scenes, revisit familiar moments with new memories, and escape an endless death loop alongside the mysterious Elinia.

apps.name: Kingdom Fall
apps.short_description: A 4-player turn-based fantasy strategy game. Roll the dice to harvest resources from numbered hex tiles, build towns and cities, trade and cast spells, then deploy your armies into massive real-time auto-battles. Five factions, sieges, Survival mode and online play with friends.

apps.name: KINGS QUARTERS
apps.short_description: A turn-based strategy board game for 2 or 4 players, with online and local multiplayer. Command soldiers, towers, assassins, and kings to outmaneuver your opponent and capture their king or claim their corner.

apps.name: Kodama: Slumber of the Gods
apps.short_description: Kodama is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure set in the world of Japanese folklore. Experience fast-paced platforming, fluid combat, and a mystical journey through a colorful, spirit-filled land.

apps.name: KUNIS
apps.short_description: Six months after the Meet & Greet went wrong, the Kunimoto Toy Mall is sealed and silent. You break in for a card no one has ever seen. The Kunis, the cats from the Kunimoto trading cards, are still here. So is Clat, a scared little clown cat who needs you as much as you need him.

apps.name: Lab Rats
apps.short_description: Fall in love with a mad scientist who kidnaps you or will you try to escape his grasp?

apps.name: Late Night Check-In
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game where you work the night shift as a hotel receptionist. Welcome uncanny guests, prepare delicious drinks to fulfill room-service requests, and watch your peaceful night job slowly turn into a living nightmare.

apps.name: Leg Day
apps.short_description: Climb to the top of this very unforgiving work out routine.

apps.name: Legends of Companion
apps.short_description:
Legends of Companion is a strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every
choice is yours. Pick from 4 classes, build deep skill trees, forge loot, recruit
a battle pet, and chart paths across diverse worlds. Master skills, gear, and team
combos to turn one spark into an unstoppable legend.

apps.name: LEGRADA
apps.short_description: A turn-based duel on a 9×9 board. Lead your Lekamon to the far edge and block your rival with wooden walls. Every figure carries an element and a skill: fire burns a wall, ice freezes a turn. Play online against real players, PC and mobile together.

apps.name: Leif's Garden Tower
apps.short_description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

apps.name: Little Big Ghost Hunter
apps.short_description:
A wholesome horror game where you play as a kid hunting ghosts in the town park, using janky gadgets and a soul-snatching camera.
One week until Midsummer. One week to capture them all.

apps.name: Locator: The Search for Abigail Lidari
apps.short_description: A Geoguessr-inspired narrative detective puzzle game set on an alien planet. As the Cartographer, you must gather and examine clues to locate missing archaeologist Abigail Lidari and uncover the fate of an ancient alien civilization.

apps.name: Lost With Mom
apps.short_description: A linear adult visual novel about a quiet 19-year-old living alone with his stepmother Rinko, an elegant model and cosmetics entrepreneur. She still treats him like her son. But the way she looks at him when the house is quiet says something else entirely.

apps.name: Low Effort Romance
apps.short_description:
Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports.
Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

apps.name: Lowside
apps.short_description: Lowside is a low-poly motorcycle racer built around the one thing that matters: Speed.

apps.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
apps.short_description: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

apps.name: Mansion of Oblivion
apps.short_description: Camera, action, a new birth. Nothing before, nothing after, only oblivion. A dirty basement, chains. No name, no past, just a Victorian mansion playing with your mind. But you're not afraid; no, you love to play too. Let the show begin!

apps.name: Marbles: Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Turn colorful chaos into satisfying order. Collect 1,800 marbles, sort them into matching jars, and unlock handy upgrades. A cozy little game to enjoy at your own pace...

apps.name: Massive Army Battle
apps.short_description: One battlefield. 2 Army! Place your troops, press START, and excitedly watch thousands of tiny warriors crash into each other in a chaos war. Free campaign with 43 levels. Unlock the Sandbox and God mode to go wild.

apps.name: MECHSQUAD
apps.short_description: Team up with friends, customize your mechs and battle for supremacy in this top-down indie shooter. Lumber into combat backed by swarms of  support units, capture strategic areas, and call in orbital fire. Up to 16 players in 2 to 4 teams experience fast-paced, LAN-ready strategic battles.

apps.name: MemeticBox
apps.short_description: A brutal voxel gore sandbox. Every body is built from blocks you can shoot, slice, burn and blow apart. Play God: hurl people, strike them with lightning, hang them or impale them on spikes. Or grab a gun for Police raids, zombie waves and fully destructible cities.

apps.name: MESHFALL
apps.short_description: An RTS where your units only take orders inside your radio network. Build relays to push the signal out and keep them alive, because the enemy goes for them first. Four maps, a hundred waves each.

apps.name: Mesozoic Protocol
apps.short_description: The dinosaurs evolve against whatever you over-build. Defend 30 outposts with eight defenses: seven buildable tower types and your HQ. Pilot a mech, then adapt as each wave pushes back. Single-player tower defense with Breach and Containment challenges.

apps.name: Midair 2
apps.short_description: Midair 2 is a fast-paced jetpack fps set in a futuristic sci-fi universe. Use movement and physics to your advantage, outwit your enemy from every angle, you'll never look at a shooter the same way again.

apps.name: Milk Homestead
apps.short_description: Inherit a mysterious estate and its secret, high-profit barn operation. Manage milk extraction, upgrade tech, and navigate seven demanding women with dynamic schedules. Explore the estate in real time and unlock over dozens of fully animated 3D explicit scenes!

apps.name: Minatro
apps.short_description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

apps.name: Ministry of Misery
apps.short_description:
Ministry of Misery (M.O.M.) is a satirical paper-pushing bureaucracy sim about power, corruption and keeping the country barely functional. 
Cause Misery. Maintain Order. Remain in Power.

apps.name: Misanthropy
apps.short_description: Misanthropy is a dark, grounded tactical social deduction shooter with realistic gunplay. Set in a fictional world with different historical eras, you play as bystanders, responders, or attackers dropped into brutal, tragic events.

apps.name: Mist Of Time
apps.short_description: Embark on a thrilling, historically accurate medieval adventure in this point-and-click MMORPG! Enjoy a simple yet addicting experience with an old-school vibe, rich content, and realistic gameplay. Dive into a unique world where casual clicking leads to endless discoveries, battles, and rewards!

apps.name: MMORPG NPC Simulator
apps.short_description: Játssz NPC-ként egy élő MMORPG-világban! Vezesd a saját boltodat, kereskedj a játékosokkal, adj küldetéseket, és küldj csapatokat raidekre ritka lootért. Építsd a hírnevedet, oldj fel Game Master-képességeket, és vedd át a szerver irányítását – belülről!

apps.name: Monquest
apps.short_description: Monsters hide under your bed, and tonight they fight back. Summon a horde of creepy creatures, defend your lair and push into the humans’ neighborhood in this lane-battle strategy game. Upgrade, collect and unleash your monster army, free to play.

apps.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
apps.short_description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!

apps.name: MOTHERWARD
apps.short_description: MOTHERWARD is a single-player psychological horror anomaly game. You are searching for your mother in an abandoned hospital. To find her, you must remember everything, uncover what you see...or don't see, and make a choice. But remember, every choice has consequences.

apps.name: Mutant Hunter
apps.short_description:
As the numbers of combat ready soldiers in the ranks of the remaining army continue to dwindle, High command devised a plan to use convicts as manpower via mind control.
Now your task is to hunt mutants around the sector using this experimental technology.

apps.name: My Little Ranch
apps.short_description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.

apps.name: My Quiet Home
apps.short_description: In My Quiet Home, everyday life revolves around completing recurring tasks. But as time passes, something begins to feel wrong. Familiar routines become unsettling, and you can't shake the feeling that you're not alone. Is someone else here?

apps.name: Neon Chase
apps.short_description: A first-person arcade shooter with no brakes, far too much neon, and a city full of things that want you dead. Dodge, shoot, smash, and ride through 15 branching stages, earn bounties, upgrade your bike, and take out endless enemies on your way to some quite disagreeable bosses. Then do it again.

apps.name: Nested Moves
apps.short_description: A customizable chess variant where every capture triggers a mini-game. Test your knowledge with trivia, roll tactical d20 checks, and challenge friends or computer opponents in local and online matches.

apps.name: NIPH
apps.short_description: NIPH is a stylish roguelite platformer with risky and intense combat. Slash, shoot, and learn and cast spells with more varied items as you explore a vast and diverse fantasy world!

apps.name: No Gasoline
apps.short_description: Carry an Atom Bomb for the Union! Build your vehicle and battle your way to the Mountain of Basil. Scavenge for parts, solve puzzles, and deliver the last hope of the labor bots!

apps.name: Nonet Concerto R
apps.short_description: Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and battle monsters with a wide range of spells in this third-person, loot-driven 3D action game. Experiment with different builds across more than 50 stages, solo or in online co-op with up to four players.

apps.name: Notary Block
apps.short_description: The watchman is dead—the knife is still out. A 3–10 player co-op horror in a Hong Kong twin-tower estate. Residents finish tonight’s duties with estate tools, then walk out through the ground gate yourself. The killer uses the same tools to hunt everyone down. No team win—only your night report.

apps.name: Nova Star: Void Survival
apps.short_description: Fight endless waves of enemies in a fast-paced roguelite space survivor. Build devastating ship combinations, unlock powerful upgrades and survive the void.

apps.name: NPUnrealSample
apps.short_description:
NPUnrealSample

Features
1. WebBrowser
- It provides common WebBrowser features like chrome and firefox.
Move pages, watch videos, download files.

2. Account Menu
- Provide account functions such as login, logout, user information inquiry, current platform inquiry, UUID inquiry, etc.

apps.name: NullGate
apps.short_description: A toon-style roguelite FPS where every arena is generated at runtime. Dash, slide and wall-kick through rooms that never repeat, weave through slow glowing bullets, and bank your kill-streak before something takes it from you. Die, upgrade at the Underdock, and dive again.

apps.name: Oathguard
apps.short_description: Defy hordes of undead as a paladin. Strike, dodge, and chain devastating abilities through cursed graveyards in this action roguelike. Evolve your Oath, collect ancient relics and unleash deadly combos every run.

apps.name: OBA DOBA
apps.short_description: OBA DOBA is a Roguelike RTS/Tower Defense that is fast, funny, and frantic. Defend your base with towers and fighters while managing your resources and upgrades. Build up your arsenal of structures, abilities, and passives to defeat the evils that await. Build, rebuild, and survive! (hopefully)

apps.name: Oil Rig Simulator
apps.short_description: Welcome aboard the oil rig, where daily challenges await around every corner. In this realistic simulation, you take on the role of an operator of one of the most technologically advanced structures in the world. This isn’t just a workplace – it’s your new life at sea.

apps.name: One Of You
apps.short_description: A group of people trying to escape a mansion. One of them is the Admin: looks like you, and can vanish whenever they want. Collect the paper scraps and crack the door code — or find them and sacrifice them to the Great Spirit.

apps.name: One Percent - A Game About Taxing Billionaires
apps.short_description: Comrade! Filthy billionaires are buying political influence again! Shoot their flying bribes from the sky in this fast incremental class struggle. Help the common people rise, don’t get corrupted, win the people’s votes, unlock powerful upgrades, and tax the billionaires out of power!

apps.name: Out Past the Horizon
apps.short_description: Escape to a sun-drenched tropical paradise in this 1-8 player life simulator. Build your dream island from scratch, cultivate vibrant farms, manage bustling local businesses, and unwind on the beach with friends. Your perfect island getaway awaits!

apps.name: Outcast Tales
apps.short_description: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

apps.name: Pancake! No break!
apps.short_description: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

apps.name: Paperly: Paper Plane Adventure
apps.short_description: Go on an exciting paper plane flight adventure, learn different flight mechanics & explore different worlds. it's all about flying a paper plane, learning from previous mistakes, and heading toward a better flight in this physics-driven gameplay.

apps.name: Pasture: The Livestock Simulator
apps.short_description: Do you have what it takes to be a cattle farmer?   Muster and manage thousands of cattle in the rugged Australian Outback, solo or with some mates. Combine the forces of man, animal and machine to get the cattle to where they need to be!

apps.name: Payback GP
apps.short_description: Race your friends in Payback GP, an arcade roguelike racing game where every defeat makes you richer! Earn cash each round, buy power-ups, evolve them throughout the game, and use them to beat your opponents and climb up the scoreboard.

apps.name: PERIHELIA
apps.short_description: One ring, one gap, and a wall closing in. You rotate a ship around the center and find the gap before the wall reaches you. Four modes, and in MUSIC every wall sits on a beat of the track. The longer you run clean, the higher the multiplier, and at x8 the whole plane tilts.

apps.name: Pfand Raiders
apps.short_description: Dash and ride through a rock festival in this absurd, music-driven co-op runner! Dodge obstacles to the beat, loot empty cans ("Pfand"), cash them in for beer and burp everything out of your way. Will you make it to The Butcher Sisters' show in time?

apps.name: Pigeon Ball
apps.short_description: Pigeon Ball is a fast-paced first-person/third-person multiplayer sports game where pigeons fly, peck, pass and battle for the ball. Master your movement, outplay your opponents and score spectacular goals in chaotic arena matches.

apps.name: Pigeon Gang
apps.short_description: Pigeon Gang is a physics-based co-op horror game for 1–6 players. Play as thieving pigeons, grab loot with your sticky tongue, explore dangerous locations, hide from monsters, and escape together. Stealing is easy. Surviving is not.

apps.name: PIGMENT LAB
apps.short_description: Chase the world’s colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land. The color difference becomes your score. 66 studies take you from the atelier to world flags and landscapes, plus a sudden-death Scoop Challenge.

apps.name: PISTA Racing PC
apps.short_description:
Fire up the engine and hit the track! PISTA Racing is now available on PC. It’s a simple, accessible arcade racing game designed for pure enjoyment.
Pick your car, hit the track, and compete to win races or beat your own best times. Easy to learn, fast-paced, and—above all—fun.

apps.name: PixelMania
apps.short_description: PixelMania is a multiplayer sandbox adventure where you can build worlds, collect and trade items, customize your character, and explore a growing universe created alongside other players.

apps.name: Plamo Kits
apps.short_description: Cut parts from sprues, paint them your way, apply decals, and assemble each kit. Pose your finished models, display them in your room, and take photos—all at your own pace in a relaxing model-building simulation.

apps.name: PlankTap
apps.short_description: There's a cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop. It floats above your windows, makes coins while you type, then trades underwater stocks and unlocks more skins. It won't interrupt your work. It's just there to be cute. That's it.

apps.name: Player 2 is a Femboy
apps.short_description: An old high school friend reconnects with you, and gaming night turns into something neither of you saw coming. Player 2 is a Femboy is a spicy visual novel about nostalgia, banter, and consequences that go further than you planned.

apps.name: Playfolk Hockey 27
apps.short_description: Run a hockey club in a league you design, then simulate, watch or play every game, from a top-down view or full 3D broadcast cameras. Set the lines and the rules, make trades, manage shifts and fatigue. Edit every league, team and player in-game, import your own or community rosters.

apps.name: Plinkdown
apps.short_description: It’s 1994 and Channel 9 is still on the air. Bounce orbs through peg boards, meet tonight’s quota, and spend what you earn at the Commissary between broadcasts. Every run goes deeper into a late-night show that should have stopped airing years ago.

apps.name: POLYSTRIKE
apps.short_description: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

apps.name: Pong Live
apps.short_description:
A modern vertical reimagining of the classic arcade experience.

Compete in fast-paced online PvP matches with your Friends and soon against the whole World.

Become a master of precision paddle control! Precision, speed, and skill decide who wins in Pong Live.

apps.name: Pourhouse: Last Call Is Your Call
apps.short_description: Pourhouse: Last Call is Your Call is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art bar management game. Serve thirsty customers and cut them off before they get carried away. Play 40 levels across 4 different bars. Upgrade your bars and unlock power-ups to help you along the way!

apps.name: President Simulator
apps.short_description: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

apps.name: Project Airline
apps.short_description: An airline management game played on a real globe. Base your aircraft, draw routes between real airports, fit the cabins and build the weekly timetable. Every departure is settled against fuel, crew, maintenance and fees, and what survives that decides how far the network can reach.

apps.name: Project Corruption
apps.short_description: Project Corruption throws you into the haunting walls of the I.B.I.S. space station as you respond to an S.O.S. signal in search of your wife. Uncover the stations dark secrets, confront monstrous horrors, and survive the aftermath of the failed experiments in immersive sci-fi horror experience.

apps.name: PURGE://PROTOCOL
apps.short_description: A neon survivors-like set inside a living and growing electronic world. Meet the locals. Dive the deep fields. Absorb what you purge. Awaken to a world that was always there. And don't worry! S.A.G.E., your helpful companion...who is certainly telling you everything...will help you along the way.

apps.name: Puzzlogue
apps.short_description: A roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you continuously swap gems to build combos and use relic effects to boost your score. Create a different build each run and clear each stage.

apps.name: QUIET
apps.short_description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting whatever lurks nearby. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

apps.name: Rally: Village Defense
apps.short_description: A cozy yet brainy Backpack-like Roguelike bullet heaven village defense. Recruit villager heroes, manage grid slots, merge orange Super Heroes, and stop the demolition crew! 50 chapters, 12 heroes, 11 Super Heroes.

apps.name: RatSpiderFrog
apps.short_description: A cursed auto-battler where you take control of a bunch of rats to fend off enemy attacks. Crossbreed them. Grill them. Feed them. Make them POWERFUL!

apps.name: RE:COPY
apps.short_description: Control a robot, push boxes, and copy sections of the grid in this Sokoban-style puzzle game. Plan what to copy, where to put it, and how to move the boxes beforehand. Work out the steps to match the arrangement of patterns on the boxes and walls to the target pattern.

apps.name: Red Rising
apps.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

apps.name: Redline County
apps.short_description: Redline County is a driving sim built on its own soft-body physics. Every tyre, spring and bushing is simulated, so a clipped kerb can bend a tie rod. Start in the Volta Hatch on the test track; the county, the career and more cars arrive in updates.

apps.name: Refund Me TD 2
apps.short_description: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

apps.name: RESIDUUM
apps.short_description: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. Armed with only a dwindling flashlight and a faulty heartbeat sensor, manage your power, uncover the truth, and escape what hides in the dark.

apps.name: Restless Rites
apps.short_description: Take care of a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

apps.name: Restoraether
apps.short_description: Restoraether is a cozy magical survival crafting game where you explore the isles of magic, mysteriously abandoned by their powerful Mage inhabitants, and restore the balance of aethers to bring magic back to the world.

apps.name: Revving: Engine Simulator
apps.short_description: Start, rev and shift 19 engines, from a Harley V-twin to a Formula 1 H16, each turning in 3D in front of you. Every sound is computed live from the simulated physics of the engine. Clutch, gas and an H-pattern on keyboard, mouse or gamepad.

apps.name: Rise of the Seraphyn
apps.short_description: An old-school 3D isometric MMORPG. Roam 100+ tiered zones, shape a character on a sprawling skill web, tame beasts, craft in 20 professions, run trade wagons for your guild, bet on arena duels, and choose a side: fight for one of four cities and let your karma decide what your wings become.

apps.name: Roadweave
apps.short_description: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, throw bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds — from a 16-area island to a map of 120 — and a new map every day.

apps.name: Robokitties: MEGASTRUCTURE
apps.short_description: Explore a dying megastructure with your friends as tiny robokitties. Scavenge dangerous loot, survive evil machines, and get back to the lift before the power runs out.

apps.name: RogueVirus
apps.short_description: Grid-based action roguelike where you face chaotic encounters against computer viruses. Build and upgrade your antivirus using a vast array of commands and add-ons in order to survive.

apps.name: Rollamech
apps.short_description: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

apps.name: Room Zero
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

apps.name: Rusty Robot Wants to Cry
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of retro-games as a roller robot. From platformers to the legendary Arkanoid, Xonix, Digger and Snake. Jump across platforms and fight glitch bosses. Colorful graphics, effects galore, and chiptune music. Anyone but a robot would cry from nostalgia!

apps.name: Sakura Shiren
apps.short_description: Hold out against endless waves of anime yokai with up to 7 friends. Draft run-changing blossom buffs between waves, spend petals on  weapons and upgrades, and face 25 hand-drawn bosses that scale to your squad.

apps.name: Sands Of Glory
apps.short_description: Sands of Glory is a skill-based 1v1 gladiator combat game where you create your own fighting style using weapons and armor that transcend the ages. Upgrade your character’s stats, earn fame by defeating your opponents in brutal arenas, and become a legendary champion.

apps.name: Scavengers of Mars
