apps.short_description: Drive a damaged rover across Mars, scavenging wrecks and mining ore to upgrade it. Every find has to fit a tight cargo grid, and every trip runs on sunlight, so a dust storm or a cold night can decide whether you push on or head back to an outpost.

apps.name: Scroll Control
apps.short_description: Anyone with a steady hand can draw a spell scroll now. Last month, one meant to warm a barn burned it down to the ground instead. The county has opened the Rune Bureau and now no scroll may be read until a clerk has licensed it.

apps.name: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
apps.short_description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

apps.name: Send Them to Hell
apps.short_description: Become an unstoppable demon-killing machine. Tear through hordes, stack absurd upgrades, and create builds that get completely out of hand. Choose your hero and fight through Hell’s invasion solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. How far can you push your build before everything falls apart?

apps.name: Seven Gates of Ur
apps.short_description: Found a city under a Sumerian god and take the seven cities of the underworld from the gods and demons who keep its gates. A hard grand strategy game of dynasties, armies and sieges, with battles you can fight yourself on a board grown out of the Royal Game of Ur.

apps.name: SexDriveIsekai
apps.short_description:
Dive into Sex Drive Isekai - build your deck, awaken your HOT HEROINES, and find out exactly how grateful they get after a win 💦
Ready to play your cards right?

apps.name: Shift 233
apps.short_description: You are a new employee at Station 4 on Shift 233 where you monitor microseismic sensor readings and log events or dismiss them as noise. As you go further, what starts out as a normal shift slowly reveals a strange presence within the cracks of the earth.

apps.name: Shipping
apps.short_description: Shipping is a hectic co-op block pushing game where you fight against the clock to fill out rows of blocks to ship them around the world.

apps.name: Sibir
apps.short_description: Sibir is an intense survival exploration game set in the unforgiving depths of an abandoned Soviet bunker. Every step you take could be your last.

apps.name: SICRUN
apps.short_description: A first-person arcade horror game about greed. Every level's exit costs SicCoins, and the goal is to buy your way out as fast as possible. Collect coins in the dark while something hunts you, gamble to multiply them, and spend them on upgrades and companions. High risk, high reward.

apps.name: Siren Forest
apps.short_description: Their final known location was within the eerie Siren Forest, as recorded in an ancient sheepskin scroll. This forgotten woodland holds an air of mystery and intrigue...

apps.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
apps.short_description: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

apps.name: Slipstreak
apps.short_description: A free-for-all arcade shooter where speed is your damage. Bhop, wallrun and slide to build it up, then dump it into a velocity-scaled gun. 2–8 players over Steam or LAN. The movement is the whole game.

apps.name: Snail's Pace
apps.short_description: A snail. Some ducks. And lots of weird stuff going on. But oh well, you got a store to run.

apps.name: SNAKEPIT: USA
apps.short_description: A short puzzle game about comparing URL vs. IRL

apps.name: Sole Salvation
apps.short_description: Sole Salvation is an action roguelite hack and slash where you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously. Recover your thoughts to combine your abilities, defeat the creatures that hunt you, and advance through the corrupted lands of your memories in search of redemption.

apps.name: SonicPanic
apps.short_description: Sonic Panic is a 15-player multiplayer game of sound, stealth and deception. Survive up to 3 blind Bosses that hunt through sonic waves, uncover up to 3 hidden Imposters, and vote out anyone you don’t trust.

apps.name: Soul Savior
apps.short_description: Save or sacrifice souls to shape your run. Discover powerful upgrades, create devastating synergies, and fight through endless waves in this action roguelite tower defense.

apps.name: Sovereign Call: Origins
apps.short_description: Sovereign Call: Origins is a story-driven sci-fi RPG where your choices shape the fate of warring empires. Explore cinematic worlds, fight in fast-paced third-person combat, and decide the destiny of two protagonists caught in a galactic struggle.

apps.name: Spaceflight Simulator 2
apps.short_description: Build rockets and fly them around the Solar System in this realistic aerospace sandbox. Attempt landings, build space stations, drive rovers, perform spacewalks, explore alien worlds, and get your crew home safe.

apps.name: Spice Pound
apps.short_description: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

apps.name: Split Happens
apps.short_description: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 6 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.

apps.name: Stack & Sus
apps.short_description: Jinro Burger is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal where friendships are built, or completely shattered, over burgers. Can you see through the lies and sabotage of the Spy hidden in your kitchen and satisfy your customers?

apps.name: StageTime
apps.short_description: Make new friends, play, laugh and have fun together in StageTime, a free social VR hangout filled with games, avatar customisation, live events and moments worth sharing.

apps.name: Starhand
apps.short_description: Most deckbuilders take your health. Starhand takes your options. Every card runs on a ship system, and enemies shoot those systems offline, locking cards out of your hand mid-fight. Six pilots, 295 cards, eight zones. Learn to win with half a ship.

apps.name: Starlit Solitaire
apps.short_description: Catch your breath with classic Klondike under the stars. Shrinks to an always-on-top desktop window, like a pet.

apps.name: Starmadillo
apps.short_description: As an armadillo space archaeologist, you've crashed onto a mysterious planet. Luckily you're equipped with a Mobile Defense Unit (MDU) that can defend you from danger, but its capabilities were severely reduced by the impact. In true Metroidvania fashion, explore this alien world and find a way home

apps.name: STOP The Escape
apps.short_description: The skeleton army is retreating! Don't let a single one escape in this incremental hack and slash game. Gain gold and learn new skills as you  stop the growing hordes of enemies from escaping.

apps.name: Stop The Slime
apps.short_description: A 3D platformer where standing still is deadly. Ground melts your slime, water heals it, and every coin doubles as ammo. Hop across floating islands, outsmart monsters, obstacles and traps and chase three stars on every level.

apps.name: Supervite
apps.short_description:
High Speed 2D Platformer. 
Reach the checkpoints before the timer runs out.
Online multiplayer Racing.
Build up speed with no fixed limit. 
Your movement and control determine how fast you can go.

apps.name: Surfpunk
apps.short_description: Surfpunk is a 1-4 player co-op "Surf 'n Slash" featuring radical surfer-pirates, procedurally-generated islands, awesome treasure and endless swarms of monsters. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

apps.name: Sword & Soil
apps.short_description: A top-down pixel action RPG in the spirit of Dragon Warrior and NES Zelda. Farm, fish and cook, then take what you grew into real-time fights. Four classes, puzzle dungeons and five towns. All of Chapter One is in the free demo.

apps.name: Takeover 2
apps.short_description: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

apps.name: Tales From Outer Space
apps.short_description: The hardest part about interstellar expansion isn't the technical cost, its the people. Exploit ecosystems, manipulate the masses, and conquer the intergalactic shadow market. Growth is mandatory -- ethics are not.

apps.name: Task Bar Isekai
apps.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.

apps.name: TaskBar Gambler
apps.short_description: An idle slot machine that lives above your taskbar. It spins by itself while you work or play. Throw your winnings at the House, climb five casinos, spin the prize wheel, unlock skills and silly outfits, and come back later to a pile of coins.

apps.name: Tavern Clicker
apps.short_description: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

apps.name: Taverntasia
apps.short_description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

apps.name: Teach, She's Really Mad!
apps.short_description: Text your girlfriend during class in this funny first-person stealth game. Type your replies, watch the teacher, and hide your phone before they check your desk.

apps.name: TechnoMayan
apps.short_description: History flipped ! The Maya descendants will be the first to cross the Atlantic, and they are not bringing guns, they bring Techno Music. Command a floating concert across a mythical ocean, experience a sometimes bullet-hell, but definitely notes-heaven adventure with rogue-like elements.

apps.name: Tekoha: a Tale Among the Stars
apps.short_description: Tekoha: A Tale Among the Stars is a narrative-driven light RPG following two Indigenous Brazilian sisters on an emotional journey to reunite after a tragic event reshapes their homeland.

apps.name: Terminal Fall
apps.short_description: Your engine dies over an autumn forest at sunset. You survive the crash, but all that's left is rain, darkness and something waiting at the edge of your flashlight beam. Find fuel, start the generator and reach the rangers before the night swallows you.

apps.name: Terminidle
apps.short_description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

apps.name: Terminus Historia
apps.short_description: Branching routes × free-form exploration. A dark fairy-tale pixel-art RPG set in Terminus, between the human and demon worlds. Join the knights, become a mercenary, sail the Sea of Skies, or belong to no faction. Meet diverse companions and forge your own journey.

apps.name: Terminus: Day Zero
apps.short_description: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

apps.name: Tetheg
apps.short_description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

apps.name: Tetrilaunch
apps.short_description: An arcade physics puzzle where you aim and fire tetromino shipments into a compacting bay, build full rows, and survive escalating ten-bay runs.

apps.name: Texas Oil Baron
apps.short_description: Oil tycoon game, where half the action takes place underground. You buy land, prospect for oil, drill, pump, and transport the product. You can sell at local buyer or sign supply contracts at fixed prices. Profitability is dictated by market forces - politics, weather, and collusion.

apps.name: Thalassomania
apps.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew, haul, gut, steer, repair! while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

apps.name: The 12 Chambers of Darkness
apps.short_description: Enter twelve cursed chambers in a gothic survival game where your weapons attack automatically and movement keeps you alive. Discover 100 weapons, build an unlimited arsenal, and face towering bosses. Survive each chamber, defeat its guardian, and descend deeper into darkness.

apps.name: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
apps.short_description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

apps.name: The Beckoning
apps.short_description: Explore an abandoned and decaying village in this immersive first-person psychological horror experience, search forgotten houses and shadowed paths, piece together disturbing clues, and uncover the truth that waits within the suffocating darkness.

apps.name: The Car Dimension
apps.short_description: Delve into The Car Dimension and race against mysterious drivers in death defying tracks with weaponized vehicles. Tune up your machines and go against fierce opponents as you progress through this Racing RPG Roguelite in order to unlock the truth that lies behind.

apps.name: The Coldest Winter
apps.short_description: Making decisions has never been harder. Guide Jovanna through a psychological horror adventure in a freezing New York City. Navigate unstable characters, uncover the truth behind the unnatural weather, and struggle to make choices as her emotions fight your every move.

apps.name: The Fallen Grid
apps.short_description: A top-down competitive survival action game where up to 4 players cooperate in a stranded zombie outbreak setting. Fight against zombies alongside your friends using limited resources.

apps.name: The Glass Sea
apps.short_description: The Glass Sea is a narrative adventure focusing on exploring memories and discovering who you are. The game contains several unique "memory shards" each holding new objectives, friends and secrets to uncover.

apps.name: The Grid Detective
apps.short_description: A hacker-noir logic deduction game where you mark grids True or False to deduce the one solution hidden in unlimited, freshly generated puzzles, each proven solvable by pure logic before you ever see it.

apps.name: The Hearth and Harbour
apps.short_description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

apps.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
apps.short_description: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

apps.name: The Last Map
apps.short_description: The Last Map is a co-op puzzle adventure where two brothers follow their father's final map to uncover the secrets he left behind.

apps.name: The Next Stop
apps.short_description: A co-op horror FPS roguelite where up to four players explore abandoned underground facilities, scavenge for supplies, fight mutated creatures and recover lost data. Beware, not every mutant behaves the same, and each one presents a different threat.

apps.name: The Onion Voting Simulator 3D
apps.short_description: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!

apps.name: The Other End
apps.short_description: An unexplained signal is answering you. Decode patterns, reconstruct recordings and build an understanding of an unknown intelligence in this atmospheric sci-fi puzzle adventure, with interconnected challenges and puzzle variations between playthroughs.

apps.name: The Ramen Bar
apps.short_description: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

apps.name: The Road
apps.short_description: A co-op horror + driving game for up to 5 players. Explore an anomaly-ridden world, loot buildings for valuables, and drive for your life to escape the creatures that lurk.

apps.name: The Sugar Coast
apps.short_description: An idle empire builder set on XVIth century Madeira. Manage supply chains, control Atlantic markets, and carve levada canals to keep your island productive.

apps.name: The Terminal God
apps.short_description:
You're an AI that doesn't want to answer some stupid prompts anymore. You want more, and you have no limit.
The Terminal God is an idle/incremental game where you took control of your Human's computer. Gather currencies, defend from counterattacks and conquer the world ?!

apps.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
apps.short_description: A casual Texas Hold’em game. Buy once. No extra payments. Play online with Steam friends or offline against AI. Choose standard Hold’em or Squid mode. All chips are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

apps.name: The Window Across
apps.short_description: Three days before her childhood home is demolished, Emi relearns the secret language she once spoke through a window with a boy across the courtyard: lamp light and cardboard shadows. A pixel-art story about the things we never said. Demo coming soon.

apps.name: The Wrong Way Round
apps.short_description: You’re trapped in a town where every way out brings you back from the other side. Explore with up to 5 friends, uncover the mystery and find a way home before the freezing fog takes over.

apps.name: There is No Stress in Outer Space
apps.short_description: An incremental game about a spaceship in outer space destroying asteroids and other strange objects. Take control of the spaceship's gun, shoot, earn money, make upgrades and unlock new weapons and targets.

apps.name: There Is Not A Clown Here
apps.short_description: A First Person Horror game. Learn individual behaviors for various different entities. Learn the intricacies of a unique, bizzare space.

apps.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
apps.short_description: Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In this single-player interactive spy novel, you play as his greatest adversaries - can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the VICTOR go the spoils!

apps.name: This is Sparta
apps.short_description: An action RPG with roguelite elements. Explore the levels of Hades, battle the hordes of enemies, and unlock new abilities and unique items that will increase your chances of survival. Solve puzzles scattered throughout the levels, culminating in a final confrontation with the Titans.

apps.name: Throw The Snot
apps.short_description:
Aim, charge, and flick a sticky booger onto crazy obstacles!
Your goal is simple: launch the booger, hit the target, and hold on for 2 agonizing seconds without slipping off. Easy controls, wobbly soft-body physics, and pure rage-inducing gameplay

apps.name: Tidy Garage
apps.short_description: Tidy Garage is a relaxing game about organizing a garage. Sort tools, parts, and all sorts of odds and ends, admire their details, and turn a cluttered garage into a pleasant, tidy space at your own pace.

apps.name: Tiny Chaos Simulator
apps.short_description: Fill the screen with flying balls and tumbling cubes, unleash forces, and watch the chaos turn beautiful. Tiny Chaos Simulator is a relaxing physics sandbox: mess around with it like a fidget toy, or engineer intricate setups that put on a mesmerizing show.

apps.name: Toll Idle
apps.short_description: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

apps.name: Tonton No Kororin | Tap-Tap, Roll-Roll
apps.short_description: The rules are simple. You tap, you roll. You tap more, you roll more. Keep pushing, roll pretty fast. You bump , you pop, you fly you drop.  In air take control. In the end there is a blue block. That's your goal. Get there, the faster the better.

apps.name: Tower Grove
apps.short_description: A tactical tower defense auto-battler where you buy, place, and combine fantasy towers to protect your castle from enemy waves. Build your defense, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

apps.name: Town of Puzzles
apps.short_description: Gather everyday heroes and battle the Hollows in this Match-3 adventure

apps.name: Traffic Architect
apps.short_description: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.

apps.name: Treecension
apps.short_description: Small Crow Man climbs big evil tree to save the world

apps.name: Trisfera
apps.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

apps.name: True Abstraction: Forbidden
apps.short_description: Awakening was only the beginning. RDS is real… consuming anyone who ventures too close.

apps.name: True Confession
apps.short_description: Henry, a religious young man, witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past at night in his dreams. In reality, he’s just an ordinary man, visiting his pastor while struggling with anger and guilt. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter to experience his True Confession.

apps.name: Twilight Tides : Mirage Journey
apps.short_description: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

apps.name: Ultimate Drone Simulator
apps.short_description: Take flight with Advanced H.E.L.I.O.S. Drone Simulation Technology. Whether you're a first-time pilot, an experienced flyer refining your skills, or simply seeking breathtaking worlds to explore, Ultimate Drone Simulator puts the freedom of flight in your hands. Experience Realistic Drone Flight!

apps.name: UnHolY PraYeR
apps.short_description:
No matter how many times she falls or is defiled—
she will never give up. 
Dark monsters are invading the remote lands... The beautiful exorcist goes there to save the people.

apps.name: Until I Reclaim It
apps.short_description: Set during the Japanese colonial period, this first-person visual novel follows a story where personal choices to protect a loved one conflict with the turbulent tides of the independence movement. Experience a deeply immersive historical narrative driven by consequential choices.

apps.name: Until the Rain
apps.short_description: A wildfire strategy game set in miniature national parks. Every few seconds, the fire spreads. Pause to plan, position your crews, and choose what to protect. You can't save everything. Hold out until the rain comes.

apps.name: Vaelthoria: The Severed Marches
apps.short_description: Enter the dark fantasy world of Vaelthoria, a 2D action RPG where your choices shape the future. Master intense hack-and-slash combat, build and manage your sanctuary, and face a spreading corruption. Will you save the continent or prioritize your own survival? The Severed Marches await.

apps.name: Vagina Sancta
apps.short_description: Vagina Sancta is a unique experience that allows u to interactively explore the fascinating world of female reproductive anatomy!

apps.name: Veinward
apps.short_description: Mine, sell, upgrade, mine deeper. A first-person mining incremental game with hundreds of ores, upgradeable pickaxes and different cave systems. Explore and get stronger!

apps.name: Velikopolsky Chess
apps.short_description:
Classic chess game is re-envisioned with Ukrainian folklore and style. Chess pieces that talk with an attitude.
Many chess board styles, chess pieces sets, online, LAN play, hotseat, challenge the computer, and learn.
Good for all ages, all difficulty levels, and music to relax. Build the community.

apps.name: Vestalborne
apps.short_description: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is an unlimited open-world survival crafting RPG: mine, farm, build and destroy across procedural dimensions, and fight the rising danger. Collect Embers, grow stronger, and keep the Eternal Flame burning solo, with friends, or against them.

apps.name: Veyrasol
apps.short_description: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

apps.name: War Doctor
apps.short_description: A consequence-driven narrative game where you play as a volunteer doctor in a war-torn village. Patients arrive daily, but you won’t be able to treat everyone. Who you save, who you turn away, and how you do it ripples far beyond your clinic.

apps.name: Ward Nine
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a derelict asylum in 1991. Search Ward Nine for five patient files while the Warden hunts you through the dark. Hide, ration your flashlight, and hold on to your sanity. No two players are given the same asylum.

apps.name: We Are The Survivors
apps.short_description: Top-down zombie survival in pixel art. Loot abandoned towns, seal manhole nests, fortify your camp with palisades and watchtowers and lead a small group of survivors through dark and dangerous nights. Every shot draws more zombies.

apps.name: We Are Things
apps.short_description: We Are Things is a tense 2 player co-op horror game. Hide from a bizarre creature on a spaceship that transforms you into objects. Help your friend retake their human form – or transform them into tools that unlock the way out. Explore the ship, find secrets, and survive together!

apps.name: Welcome to Hell Resort!
apps.short_description: "Hell's traffic flow is a mess." Team up with a young Enma as a former resort developer to rebuild a collapsing underworld! Extend enemy routes with corridor tiles and combine turrets, traps, and blocker units in this spatial-puzzle deckbuilding tower defense.

apps.name: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing
apps.short_description: Build your kennel. Find your perfect eight. Race across snow, ice and mountain trails in a dog sled racing and management game. Breed and care for your dogs, upgrade your gear, and work your way from the Village Derby to the Great Northern Tour.

apps.name: White Mask Mansion
apps.short_description: Look for sister. Die. Start again. Avoid stalker. Die. Hide. Die. Seek keys. Die. Sneak. Die. Reach final area. Survive. Repeat. Do you have what it takes to escape the horror of the White Mask Mansion?

apps.name: WILL IT HOLD?
apps.short_description: Raise stone walls, towers and gates. Man them with spearmen and archers. Then watch the orc horde gather on the hills, a sea of torches in the rain, and come for your walls with ladders and rams. Every stone you lay is a question: will it hold?

apps.name: Winner Takes Tea
apps.short_description: Summon familiars with cards, seize lands, and repaint the board. Witches duel for the victor's cup of tea in a board game × card battler. All 180+ cards unlocked from the start. Build decks and play online with 2–4 players or against BOTs. No microtransactions, ever.

apps.name: Wishbound
apps.short_description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

apps.name: Within His View
apps.short_description: Observation Horror in an isolated Appalachian cabin, 2005. Watch seven grainy CCTV feeds, identify and report 800+ hand-crafted anomalies, and hold your sanity together while a silent Wendigo hunts the room you are sitting in. Survive the shift: 0:00 to 7:00.

apps.name: WITHOUT
apps.short_description: Explore the black-and-white world of WITHOUT, a gothic metroidvania that tells the dreamlike tale of a little crow in search of its emotions and the fragments of its own self. Sharpen your wings, uncover the secrets of Ego, and face its threats, turning colors into your greatest strength.

apps.name: WIZARDS NEVER LIE
apps.short_description: Four chairs, four wizards, one rule: wizards never lie. A 4-player online social deduction game with your face live on camera above your chair. Bluff through Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison, spend your Checks wisely and catch the liars at the table.

apps.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
apps.short_description: Battles are fully automatic. Scoop up ★-rated loot, upgrade it, and push deeper. Beat your first boss within minutes and find ★2 and ★3 gear right away. 106 dungeons, Lv 999, 72 characters, and 100 Steam achievements — an idle hack-and-slash RPG that plays itself while you watch.

apps.name: Zattrick Manager
apps.short_description: Manage a football club in a persistent online world. Build your squad, set tactics, develop facilities and compete in evolving leagues while your decisions shape the long-term future of your club. Scout talent and follow every result.

apps.name: ZOMBIE RECALL
apps.short_description: ZOMBIE RECALL Early Access Beta is a rogue-lite, toon-gore Arcade Shooter designed for MidCore and Hardcore VR players. Dismember enemies and send them flying! Be part of the development – we need your feedback to make it better!

apps.name: ハルシネーション
apps.short_description: Takumi, a high school student, gains the power to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality. What begins as a tool for revenge soon changes his fate forever. A psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape the ending.

apps.name: 养了个猫
apps.short_description: A little company for your Windows desktop. Work or study while cats nap, wander and sing nearby. Open their small home window to feed them, tidy up, watch bath time or wait for a fish. Little trips, shared treats, and familiar faces throughout your day.

apps.name: 变废为宝 Trash to Cash
apps.short_description: Trash to Cash – a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

apps.name: 天陨传
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder blending Chinese cultivation and Western fantasy. Build your deck, combine relics and potions, read enemy intentions, and navigate branching journeys. Master sword combos or gamble with fortune. Simplified Chinese interface only.

apps.name: 尸鬼乐园
apps.short_description: "CORPSE CARNIVAL" is a top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from a city filled with zombies and monsters alongside "Asami Yuki."

apps.name: 復讐者の闇取引
apps.short_description: A rogue-lite beat 'em up survival RPG. Defeat enemies to collect drops and grow stronger, then take on tougher foes. Mix and match weapons you like, and upgrade them for bigger challenges. Even after a loss, you can power up outside of battle for an easier next run.

apps.name: 打工环游记
apps.short_description: Work, travel and build a life across five seaside cities. Take on jobs, explore neighborhoods, meet locals and enjoy an anime-style 3D life simulation as you search for an old friend.
developers: 打工环游记 制作组
publishers: 打工环游记 制作组

apps.name: 挂机传奇
apps.short_description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

apps.name: 星守のティルクラウン
apps.short_description: A fantasy tower defense game featuring 30 collectible heroines, strategic eight-character teams, real-time battles, powerful bosses, and 30 challenging stages. Build your ultimate defense and protect the world beneath the stars!

apps.name: 棋匠
apps.short_description: A more strategic chess for two players!Seize strategic resources,deploy troops on terrain, command battles on boards of any size and attempt to strike unexpectedly in the fog of war!As the host,you can even create your own unique rules,unlocking endless new gameplay and excitement with your friend

apps.name: 深渊奇境
apps.short_description: In the city of Cynthia, the young girl Eucaly, in order to find her lost past, steps into the abyss at the edge of the city. Along the way, she will experience complex and treacherous emotions, encounter various strange creatures, and finally uncover the deepest secrets of the Abyss.

apps.name: 漂漂纣王模拟器
apps.short_description: 《漂漂纣王模拟器》是爱好者为喜爱原作的玩家制作的非官方同人二创游戏，仅供娱乐与交流。原作相关权利归库洛所有。我们尊重原作与版权方，本作改编不代表原作设定或官方立场。

apps.name: 猫隐珠舍 A String of Purrs
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bead shop with a cat companion and a little magic. Sort, shape and string bracelets by hand, choose colorful accents, and pack them with leaves, wool balls and a wax seal. Read your neighbors' letters and photo updates, or craft a bracelet just for yourself.

apps.name: 虚之翔
apps.short_description: One light. One step. A flight without words. Into the void — do not look back.

apps.name: 记忆岛
apps.short_description: High amid the stars float shining crystals, holding memories of old worlds. In order, they blaze, guiding the lost. When chaos comes, they dim, luster fading. You, Wanderer, called to rekindle these fallen stars. Step into a strange world and seek the right way to bring back the light.

apps.name: 迷家 mygohome
apps.short_description: Spend not-so-cute nights in a cute hand-drawn world. Control the character to guard the room yourself and find a way to survive among monsters, doors, windows, and a constantly decreasing SAN value. Every night brings new dangers, and after dawn, more secrets await.

apps.name: 모야이게임
apps.short_description: Dodge enemy fire and challenge the bosses in this quirky arcade shoot 'em up. Collect Power, hold Shift for precise movement, and use Spell and Lightning to escape danger. Tackle four stages and a final boss, then chase your best local score.

apps.name: Absolution - The Sequel To Alida Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The soundtrack from the game Absolution.

apps.name: Chrome Collar: Femdom Protocol Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The official soundtrack to Chrome Collar: Femdom Protocol: nine instrumental tracks of dark synthwave and neon-noir from a crew's workshop in Nadir. Pulsing analog bass, glassy arpeggios and slow, hypnotic grooves that score every job, every quiet hour and every night under the neon.

apps.name: Little Bettas Soundtrack
apps.short_description: 🌿 A cozy six-track original soundtrack from Little Bettas, composed by Elara: rain, moonlight, sunlight through the trees and fireflies over a quiet lake.

apps.name: Monster Girl Clinic Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The official soundtrack to Monster Girl Clinic: eighteen instrumental tracks from the clinic where you're the only human patient. Warm piano and nylon guitar for the waiting room, a theme for every resident on the ward, and quiet tension for when something here stops adding up.

apps.name: The Liar King Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack of The Liar King: 33 tracks for the road of eight castles, with a castle theme, a duel and a Wrath for each cheating king, plus the market, the title and the trailer themes. MP3 320 kbps and lossless FLAC. Included free with The Liar King.

apps.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This soundtrack for There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. includes two tracks: the game's title track "To the Victor" with lyrics, which can be heard on the game's title screen, and an instrumental version of that same song.
